name: Simplified Parallel Voxelization
definition: A voxelization method for uniform grids where objects are assumed to be smaller than grid cells. It voxelizes the 8 corner points of an object's bounding box in parallel to populate the grid.
summary: Simplified Parallel Voxelization populates uniform grids by voxelizing only an object's eight bounding box corners, enabling efficient, loop-free parallel processing on SIMD hardware without edge traversal.
